verdict: C — DD overlay controls MDD (58.1 -> 35.0%) but kills CAGR (13.3 -> 9.5%). FF5 alpha survives (+4.52%) but too weak. Not promotion candidate.

gate0_pit.detail: All C1-C11 passed. DD overlay properly uses t-1 lag. Key verification: line 40 dd_lag = c(0, dd_pct[-n_f]) shifts drawdown by 1 day.

gate1_performance.detail: MDD improved from 58.1% to 35.0% (PASS <45%). But CAGR dropped from 13.3% to 9.5% (28% sacrifice). SR improved slightly 0.547->0.620 due to vol compression. Worst month improved dramatically -30.1%->-11.4%.

gate2_artifacts.files: performance.csv, hurdle_result.json, sim_result.rds, equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, analysis_multifactor.csv

gate3_role_honesty.detail: CAGR 9.5% is below BM-neutral threshold for core_alpha. MDD now acceptable but return insufficient. Diversifier role is honest — provides downside protection but not standalone alpha.

gate4_statistical.detail: OOS ratio 0.156 is very low — alpha concentrated in-sample. Rolling Sharpe positive 82.6% is decent. Alpha trend slope 0.036 essentially flat.

gate5_ff5.detail: FF5 alpha remains positive (+4.52%/yr) after DD overlay. Alpha survival rate 68.4% (6.61%->4.52%). t-stat 1.163 — not significant but positive. The tight DD kills ~1/3 of the alpha. HML loading negative (-0.38) suggests anti-value tilt after sector neutralization.

comparison_note: Best SR per unit CAGR sacrifice among 3 variants. MDD control effective. But OOS 0.156 is a red flag across all variants.
promotion_reason: CAGR 9.5% < 16% target. OOS 0.156 too weak. FF5 alpha positive but t<1.96.
